newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai central bank denies finance firms in trouble.
newsitem.headline: Thai central bank denies finance firms in trouble.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand denied market rumours on Thursday that some local finance and brokerage firms were facing problems due to loan defaults by indebted stock investors.

The Central bank spokeswoman Kleo-thong Hetrakul told Reuters all finance and brokerage firms were in sound positions in honouring any cash withdrawals by clients and none have been put under special supervision by the authorities.
Her statement followed rumours on Thursday that at least four finance and brokerage firms faced financial problems from loan defaults.
The Stock Exchange of Thailand denied the rumours and said they were not correct.

"All finance (and brokerage) firms can meet obligations of honouring withdrawal demand. They are in sound financial positions and maintain reserves of between 50 and 100 percent for securities assets that they hold or handle," Kleo-thong said.
The central bank supervises Thai finance companies which are mostly also licensed as brokerage houses.
The spokeswoman said no finance or brokerage firms had sought assistance from the central bank.
